caption: The video captures a wide beach scene under a layered sunset sky of orange, gold and teal clouds, with a bright sun glow near the center-right horizon. A band of surf runs horizontally across the middle of the scene, where low white foam crests continuously churn and reshape. The foreground is a flat sheet of wet sand mirroring the warm and cool tones above, its reflection patches shimmering and reorganizing as the thin water film shifts over the ripples, with faint seams tracing across the sand. The cloud formations and horizon line appear steady, and the framing holds the horizon height and composition consistent. The surf zone keeps breaking while the glowing reflection persists.
relations: Low surf cresting continuously churns and reshapes the white foam band across the middle.
Thin water film shifting over ripples reorganizes the shimmering reflection patches on wet sand.
Steady cloud bands and horizon keep the warm-cool glow mirrored persistently on the sand.
